title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: 按照中国民间的传统习俗，春节期间长辈通常会给孩子发红包，俗称发压岁钱 (lucky money), 以表达对孩子的祝福，祝他们好运。如今，红包不仅是给孩子的礼物，而且经常也是给长辈或亲朋好友的礼物。近年来，随着微信用户数量的增加，微信红包变得愈加流行。欢度春节时，人们经常互发微信红包表达问候。这无疑是一种与远方亲友联系的便捷方式。
reference: According to traditional Chinese folk customs, during the Spring Festival the elders usually give children red envelopes, commonly known as lucky money, to express their blessings and wish them good luck. Nowadays, red envelopes are not only a gift for children but also often a gift for the elders, relatives and friends. In recent years, with the increasing number of WeChat users, WeChat red envelopes have become increasingly popular. When celebrating the Spring Festival, people often send WeChat red envelopes to each other to express their greetings. This is undoubtedly a convenient way of staying in touch with relatives and friends far away.
